name: cross-functional-flowchart
description: Evaluate and improve Cross-Functional Flowchart drawings — a process where who performs each step matters as much as the order
goal: Reach a consistent 16+/20, with every node connected and drawn from a BASFLO_M.VSSX master

prompts.text: Build a cross-functional flowchart for purchase approval across Requester, Finance and Procurement, showing who does each step
Build a swimlane diagram for hiring across Hiring Manager, Recruiter and Candidate, from vacancy to signed offer
Build a cross-functional flowchart for a change request across Requester, Change Board and Operations
Build a swimlane diagram for an invoice dispute across Customer, Accounts Receivable and Sales
